in_marathi.name: Santoshini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of joy, contentment
in_marathi.long_meaning: Santoshini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Santoshini is a name derived from the word Santosh, meaning happiness, joy, or contentment. In Hindu mythology, she is a form of Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. Santoshini is believed to bring happiness and contentment to those who call upon her.
